title: Base change of a first order thickening, with its ideal sheaf
statement: Let $i:W\to W'$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose ideal sheaf $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_{W'}\to i_*\mathcal O_W)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] satisfies $\mathcal I^2=0$, i.e. $W\subset W'$ is a first order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Let $p:Z'\to W'$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $Z=Z'\times_{W'}W$ the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of $p$ and $i$, with projections $j:Z\to Z'$ and $q:Z\to W$, so that $p\circ j=i\circ q$. Then $j$ is a closed immersion whose ideal sheaf is $\mathcal I\mathcal O_{Z'}=\operatorname{Im}(p^*\mathcal I\to p^*\mathcal O_{W'}\to\mathcal O_{Z'})$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal], [def-pc-module-pullback], and $(\mathcal I\mathcal O_{Z'})^2=0$; that is, $Z\subset Z'$ is a first order thickening and $(q,p):(Z\subset Z')\to(W\subset W')$ is a morphism of thickenings.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma 09ZU (lemma-base-change-thickening; proof omitted in the source), with Schemes, Lemma 01JU (schemes-lemma-fibre-product-immersion) part (1) for the ideal sheaf Im(g^*I -> O_Y) of a base-changed closed immersion (literature/stacks-project/schemes.tex)

proof.text: Install the closed immersion component of the first order thickening hypothesis as a local instance. Stability of closed immersions under base change gives IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst p i).

Apply the proved Mathlib theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion i p to identify the kernel of the first projection with i.ker.comap p. This is precisely the recorded extended ideal; no additional affine quotient calculation is needed.

Use the already-proved source-library theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_pow p i.ker 2 (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.IdealSheaf.Functorial) to rewrite (i.ker.comap p)^2 as (i.ker^2).comap p. Rewrite by the square-zero component of the hypothesis and the Mathlib theorem Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_bot. Hence the extended ideal has square zero.

Rewrite the kernel by step 2 and apply step 3 to assemble the first order thickening of the first projection. Pair this with the kernel identity, square-zero identity, and pullback.condition p i to obtain all four clauses.
